description: georisques.gouv.fr: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by georisques.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by georisques.gouv.fr. The listing groups 13 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Coût moyen par commune des sinistres inondation sur la période 1995-20; Données produites par le SIG Directive inondation du territoire à risq; Atlas des Zones Inondables en Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - Extraction Géoris; Plan de prévention des risques naturels d'inondation - PPRi - des rivi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
